# ssync_mapper_object (Resource)

The mapper_object records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_type` (Dynamic)
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `kind` (Dynamic)
- `provider_id` (String)

### Optional

- `data` (Dynamic)
- `data_id` (String)
- `filter` (Dynamic) Filter values by key; a key may not be blank
- `mapper_id` (String) The mapper the object belongs to, by its key
- `sa_owner_id` (String) The owner of the mapper when left out
- `target` (String)
